title: Watch HUD + device overlays
status: built 2026-11-07, untested in game - jmfsb_watch (core, self_aid, recon, engineer, team_lead, jfo, tablet panel, side 2, settings section, HUD toggles, key hint icons, own charges, alerts), jmfsb_medic (medical: triage suggest + set, MIST thread per patient, alerts), jmfsb_c2 (measures, HUD toggle with LOA / NFA locked on). Gaps: MIST reply carries the full card (not changes only); no squad-lead tag / FLASH on T1 (composer takes no tags); squad view is tap only (no hold); jamming not counted in NO SIGNAL; clacker holder not shown; server locks are CBA's own force, no lock icon beyond the settings app's

terms.phone: means phone, side and side 2 devices unless stated
terms.hud: AiTR world-space panels/boxes drawn on targets
terms.overlay: watch panel drawn on the devices
terms.profile: a class/skill set: fields, gate, report template, actions

core.add_remove: look at target + action key (numpad 9); again on same target removes
core.add_from_list: settings app can add a squad member without looking
core.slot_list_shared: hud and overlay both read the same slot list
core.multi_profile: units with more than one profile cycle with the cycle key; side 2 can show a second profile
core.notifications: all alerts go through the existing framework notification row - no new popups

hud.anchor: world-space, attached to target, moves with it
hud.clear_zone: nothing screen-fixed in center; world panels only cover view when target is there
hud.shrink_setting: on by default, can be turned off
hud.toggle: own on/off per profile in settings

devices.side: primary watch surface, portrait, left or right edge
devices.phone: fallback only if no side device: top strip temporarily replaces part of phone screen, reverts when slots empty

overlay.walking_mode: compact rows, never in clear zone, map/BFT stays visible
overlay.raised_mode: same 4 slots as 4 columns with full field set + actions

row_line_3: last report age or one extra value
template.action_bar: fixed order, profile hides unused actions

actions.report: opens profile report template prefilled; first send starts a thread, later sends reply with changes only
actions.share: every friendly player within share_range_m sees it for share_seconds, even without LOS

border.solid: line of sight or live data
border.dashed: no line of sight or stale

visual_rules.triage_colours_note: must match unit ACM docs; change if docs use a different scheme (e.g. T4 expectant)

numpad_layout.9: ACTION key - context action on what you look at (e.g. medic looks at player -> opens med hud panel / adds slot; again on same target removes)

keys.change_note: replaces old map (device buttons were numpad 6/7/8/9 accept/ear/mute/decline). UPDATE DOCS AND SIGNAGE: wiki key pages, smart cards, device art/labels, in-game key hints
keys.f1_f4_functions: keep current device functions unless reassigned; key hints show what each is set to
keys.action_key_9: replaces the separate add_remove key in all profiles
keys.other_hud_bindings_open: OPEN - which keys these use now that 1-9/0/. are taken (CBA keybinds, or assign to F1-F4 while a profile is on)

key_hints.what: small icon + key label next to each key on the active device edge (or by phone if no side device)
key_hints.icon_follows_profile: e.g. report key = med kit in medic, binoculars in recon
key_hints.visible: only while a profile is on

full: key hints: icon + key + short label
context prompt when looking at a valid target, e.g. '9: open med panel', shown on the device next to the 9 hint (never in clear zone)
reduced: no context prompt text; 9 hint icon lights up when a valid target is looked at

settings_app.location: phone app, also controls side devices
rows: profile on/off (only profiles the unit is gated for)
slot list: pin / clear / add from squad list

hud_settings_page.per_section: type on/off, then on/off per data field (e.g. vitals, meds, MIST age, range/bearing, dashed contacts)
hud_settings_page.effect: hides for this player only; data still syncs, others unaffected
hud_settings_page.server_locks: mission maker can lock any row ON via CBA server setting; locked rows show a lock icon

sync.owner: data lives on the machine that owns the target
sync.watchers_list: each target keeps a list of watchers so several players can watch it
sync.los_checks: server, ~1 Hz, only for tracked recon/eng contacts

profiles.gate: CLS or Medic skill (OPEN: exact ACM/ACE variable)

hud.open: look at player within 5 m + action key (numpad 9): full panel over patient
hud.persist: panel stays over patient when medic looks away, follows carry/load

profiles.triage: auto-suggested from vitals using doc thresholds; medic override sticks until changed

prefill.T: ACE treatment log: TQs with times, meds, fluids

report.updates: reply in same thread, changes only
report.stale_warning: triage changed since last send OR older than 5 min

visibility.los: any friendly player has LOS -> solid box, all friendly players within 2 km see box + map track
visibility.no_los: dashed box at last known position, spotter's group only, shows time lost
visibility.regain: back to solid when anyone has LOS

profiles.open: share now overlaps 2 km LOS rule - proposed: share pushes a no-LOS contact to everyone in 2 km for share_seconds

profiles.note: JFO must receive support asset questions (BDA, clearance etc.) on phone/side device via messaging threads

profiles.gate: TL and ATL (OPEN: exact role var; isJFO is false for ATL)

hud.scope_open: own squad only or any friendly - OPEN

squad_view.open: while key held, or tap = show for squad_view_seconds
squad_view.no_signal: shown when member's device is jammed or off

profiles.note: use vanilla in-game side windows (custom info panels); no custom drone hud

threats.detect: engineer sees enemy IEDs/mines/explosives within range, no detector needed
threats.visibility: same as recon: LOS -> friendly within 2 km + map track; no LOS -> finder's group, dashed

vehicle_look: can repair with what you carry

c2_app.create_edit_delete: TL and ATL (creator, TL or ATL can edit/delete)
c2_app.flow: pick type -> draw on map -> name (required) -> save
c2_app.visible_to: whole side on map/BFT (default; OPEN: limit to squad/platoon)

hud.objective_area: keeps outline to 1 km, no dot

per_type.loa: red line, warn when close, do not cross
per_type.boundary: thin line, own vs adjacent unit, warn when crossing
per_type.no_fire_area: red hatched; support requests from inside it are blocked (links JFO)

later.note: LZ marker panel: inbound ETA, wind, patients tagged from MIST threads
emitters: type, strength, bearing; after EW zones

open_questions: exact engineer trigger fields ACE exposes
rows locked by default beyond c2 loa / no_fire_area
docs_todo: update key docs and signage for new numpad map (wiki, smart cards, device labels, key hints)
document C2 app measures and HUD ranges
document HUD settings page and server locks
build_order: core slot list + settings app + key hints

decisions_2026_11_07.numpad: adopt the remap: 1-4 nets, 5-8 device F1-F4, 9 action key, 0/. arrows; net 5 unbound; saved binds migrated
decisions_2026_11_07.hud_keys: while a profile is on, F1-F4 (numpad 5-8) are report / cycle profile / all off / squad view (hold); key hints show it
decisions_2026_11_07.medical_gate: anyone in AiTR goggles (ECOTI drawing); CLS and others see the cls tier, medics the medic tier
decisions_2026_11_07.medical_target: any player looked at within 5 m
decisions_2026_11_07.handoff: both keep it - several watchers per patient
decisions_2026_11_07.recon_share: push a no-LOS contact to every friendly within 2 km for share_seconds
decisions_2026_11_07.phone: inside the phone display as an overlay when active (no side device)
